run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations and print average time in milliseconds
test_time_func_with_custom_iterations: test time_func by passing a custom number of iterations to benchmark a function
test_time_func_with_name: test time_func by providing a custom name label for the benchmark output
refactor_time_func_warmup: refactor time_func to adjust the warmup iteration count before timing begins
summarize_time_func: summarize the time_func utility that warms up then times a callable and prints average ms per call
